value.finding: context-pack accepts current_state and changed_since_last_run but does not compute a before/after delta. A standalone structural diff is a real public edge utility: before/after -> path-sorted added/removed/changed. No model, no network, no authority.

duplication.finding: No package in this repo compares two caller-supplied JSON objects. context-pack consumes a precomputed delta field. cheap-route scores routes. proof-card projects one record. The starter core writes receipts and manifests.

public_boundary.finding: Generic local JSON comparison of caller-supplied objects. Fail-closed on private/conversational keys. No AXON/Mother/Governance/recipes/weights/scoring/prompts/customer data/production authority/private URLs. No private-repo imports.

limitations: Reports differences only. Grants no mutation or production authority.
Not a lifecycle attestation, reconciliation proposal, or private state store.
